A separately executable direct and DP comparison checks 48,200 words across 1,125 fibers; further 17,885 candidate-fiber calculations test the symbolic collision formula. Finite checks support but do not replace the unrestricted proof.

value.rationale: This exactly answers a natural conditional-count problem in the same 2-deck languages and universality framework motivating the 2026 primary source: every fiber has 0, 1, or 2 exceptional words, with an explicit arithmetic formula, a computable conditional proportion, and a composition-wide identity. The all-parameter structural exception bound is informative even when the class has exponentially many words, and is not a merely finite or artificial parameter census.
